hero.title: What can we help with today?
hero.copy: Pop into 3 Meadow Lane for free NHS treatment through Pharmacy First, drop off or collect a repeat prescription, or ask our team for confidential advice at the counter. No appointment needed.

primaryTasks.title: NHS Pharmacy First
primaryTasks.copy: Free NHS treatment and advice for seven common conditions, without waiting for a GP appointment.

primaryTasks.title: Order a repeat prescription
primaryTasks.copy: Nominate us in the NHS App, or order by phone or in person — see how long it takes to be ready.

alert.title: Flu and COVID-19 vaccinations
alert.copy: Seasonal vaccinations usually run from September to March each year — check current NHS eligibility and book at the counter or online nearer the time.
